bug_info.bug_desc: In keymgr_kmac_if, the decoy values generated when no real digest or data is being presented were not properly diversified. For data_o, the old DecoyOutputCopies parameter included a factor of Shares and the idle/decoy assignment replicated only entropy_i[0], so both share halves of data_o became identical copies of the same entropy share. In the masked share representation this makes the effective decoy value zero when observed on the sideload/data paths. In addition, the decoy_data used for kmac_data_o.data was driven directly from raw entropy_i[1] without an extra permutation, so the KMAC decoy stream was not independently randomized from the share values used elsewhere. These weaknesses affect invalid operations, idle behavior, and any clearing/decoy path that must present randomized, non-correlated share data.
bug_info.fix_hint: Diversify the decoy values per share and per destination. For data_o, compute the number of copies per share as (AppDigestW / RandWidth) rather than multiplying by Shares, and drive the upper share output from entropy_i[1] and the lower share output from entropy_i[0]. For the KMAC data path, generate decoy_data from a separately permuted version of entropy_i[1] (for example perm_data(entropy_i[1], RndCnstRandPerm)) so that the decoy stream is not merely the raw entropy share and is non-deterministic relative to the other share.
